name: context-relay
description: Context weather, prompt-cache warming and one-click handoff of the conversation into a fresh chat: one band above the prompt.

warm.title: Keep the prompt cache warm
warm.description: While the session idles, ping the model from the cache every 55 minutes for this many hours so the cache never cools. Each ping spends the 5-hour limit and reads the whole context from cache.

autoHandoffAt.title: Automatic handoff at (tokens)
autoHandoffAt.description: When the context reaches this many tokens after a turn, collect a handoff and clear the chat after a countdown. 0 disables.

countdownSeconds.title: Countdown before an automatic clear (seconds)
countdownSeconds.description: How long the Yes / No question stays under the band before the automatic handoff goes ahead.

bands.title: Weather band boundaries (tokens)
bands.description: Three rising numbers separated by commas: Clear below the first, Overcast below the second, Rain below the third, Storm from the third up.

handoffDir.title: Handoff folder
handoffDir.description: Where handoff files are written. Empty means ~/.claude/context-relay/handoff.
